reference.authors: Alex E. Yuan and Wenying Shou
reference.statistic: abs(mean(x * y)); full-series sample-SD-scaled first differences

reference.normalization_note: Shine's Python np.std uses ddof=0; its unsmoothed magnitudes are m/(m-1) times the sample-SD definition. That code is not executed by this generator.
